description: Total phosphorus (mg/L as P) at CRP stations 13202, 15816 and 17410, pooled. Regression on the log1p scale. No event target: no threshold is agreed. Features are same-visit readings (a nowcast), not a forecast.

baseline_meaning.persistence: the last sample at this station, carried forward (the previous label at the same station on a strictly earlier date; with no earlier label, the training median)
baseline_meaning.seasonal_climatology: the mean of the training targets within plus or minus 1 calendar month(s) of the test month, pooled over the task's stations (with fewer than 3 training labels in that window, the mean of all training targets)

conformal.method: split-conformal on absolute walk-forward residuals (transformed scale)
